25 th June, 2018 

To 

All Insurance Brokers, The Principal Officers, 

Re : Clarifications on 

   - 2017-18 

   - a) Annual licence fee payable by license_d broking entities for the year 

   - b) Renewal Fee payable as per Reg 9 of IRDAI (Insurance Brokers ) Regulations, 2018 

1. The Authority has been rece1vmg queries from the licensed brokers seeking clarification regarding amount of fee payable by the broker during the current financial year i.e.2018-19. 

2. Attention is drawn to Reg. 9 of the IRDAI (Insurance Brokers) the application for renewal of Certificate of Registration. The same 1s annual licence fee. As you are aware renewal fee is payable while filing payable for the validity period of the Certificate of Registration. Regulations, 2018 introducing the new concept of renewal fee in place of

4. As regards Renewal fee, it is clarified as follows 

- Composite Brokers. the financial year 2018-19 shall pay renewal fee at the time of filing renewal application. The renewal fee shall be Rs. 1,00,000/- for Direct Brokers, Rs. 3,00,000 /- for Reinsurance Brokers and Rs. 5,00,000 /- for 

- a) Those brokers, whose certificate of registration is due for renewal during

- b) Those brokers whose renewal of certificate of registration is due in 201920, the renewal fee shall be Rs. 35000 /- for Direct Brokers and Rs. **Fee** along with the **Annual Licence Fee** stated at point no. 3 .
